item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs mdel kha gsang ba'i tan tra las nang gtor ma'i zlog pa
item.coloph: mdel kha gsang ba'i tan tra las/ dbal chen khro bo'i gtor bzlog (zlog) gsang ba 'dus pa'i thugs kyi brnag pa/ stag la me 'bar gyi phyag cha/ dbra btsun mu la rad nas (na'i) snyan du brgyud pa'o//
